verdict.rationale: UK Visas and Immigration publishes extensive web guidance on GOV.UK, so it is fair to ask whether it offers llms.txt or agent-oriented docs. The evidence pack shows only human-oriented guidance pages, an ID Check app and email alerts. Nothing shows an llms.txt file, machine-readable agent docs or any guidance aimed at AI agents, so the axis applies but there is no evidence it is delivered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
